summary: Solve direct or recursive equations with assumptions, cases, certificates, units, and structured conditions. Batch or map owned tables, continue prior results, calculate matrices/calculus, and normalize strict LaTeX. Verification and completeness remain separate.

tools.name: tool_math_solve
tools.purpose: Evaluate expressions or solve direct/recursive systems with optional assumptions, cases, units, and certified real polynomial roots.

tools.name: tool_math_batch
tools.purpose: Evaluate up to 32 records with indexed partial progress and ordered final results.

tools.name: tool_math_continue
tools.purpose: Continue one selected prior solution/value while preserving units, domain facts, and approximation scope.

tools.name: tool_math_table
tools.purpose: Apply a formula to a caller-owned numeric attached table page with progress.
tools.connection: Existing table registry and bounded SymPy workers

tools.name: tool_math_matrix
tools.purpose: Exact arithmetic, inverse, determinant, rank, reduction and solving for matrices up to 8 by 8.

tools.name: tool_math_calculus
tools.purpose: Differentiate or integrate restricted expressions with domain and branch evidence.

params.name: equation
params.description: String or structured controls: expression string/equality list, syntax math/latex, solve_for, domain, precision, assumptions, split_cases, method including certified, units/output_units, numerical hints, and trace.

params.name: data
params.description: JSON list of constant, variable-reference, or recursive equation bindings; [] when none.

params.name: equation
params.description: Shared equation string or structured controls, as solve accepts.

params.name: data
params.description: 1–32 records with optional id and independent recursive data bindings. Validation/math errors remain local; order is preserved.

params.description: Next equation string or structured controls.

params.description: previous result object; solution_index or slot:value/value_name; optional bindings. Approximate reuse requires allow_approximate:true. Opaque facts cannot be reused.

params.name: data
params.description: matrices: one or two finite constant-expression matrices <=8x8; precision15–100; syntax math/latex. solve uses [A,b] for Ax=b.

params.name: data
params.description: operation differentiate/integrate, variable, optional derivative order1–8, domain real/complex, finite real integration bounds, precision15–100, syntax math/latex. Retain domain and branch conditions.

workflow.explanation: Supply formula/system and bindings. Declare assumptions and physical units, or enable bounded parameter cases. Certified mode covers only supported exact real rational-polynomial roots. Inspect conditions, verification, completeness, and diagnostics.
Reuse the equation/options across independent records; inspect each row and retry unfinished rows in smaller batches.
